class Point {
  x;
  constructor(input: {x: number}) {
    ({x: this.x} = input);
  }
}
new Point({x: 1}).x = 'wrong';
class Optional {
  value;
  constructor(input: {value: number}, flag: boolean) {
    if (flag) ({value: this.value} = input);
  }
}
const required: number = new Optional({value: 1}, false).value;
class Nested {
  value;
  tail;
  rest;
  constructor(input: {nested: {value?: number}; extra: string}, values: [number, ...string[]]) {
    ({nested: {value: this.value = 9}, ...this.rest} = input);
    [, ...this.tail] = values;
  }
}
const nested = new Nested({nested: {}, extra: 'kept'}, [1, 'a']);
nested.value = 'wrong';
nested.tail = [true];
nested.rest = {extra: 1};
class Definite {
  value: number;
  constructor(input: {value: number}, flag: boolean) {
    if (flag) ({value: this.value} = input);
  }
}
